title: Quorum 读写集合：W + R > N 判据与暴力枚举互证
expected_output:

N     W     R     W+R>N       判据强一致      枚举互证        一致
3     2     2     4>3         True            True            True
3     1     1     2>3         False           False           True
3     2     1     3>3         False           False           True

判据与暴力枚举完全一致 : True

容错能力（允许同时故障的节点数）：
  N=5 W=3 R=3 : 容忍 2 个节点故障仍可写、2 个仍可读
  N=5 W=2 R=2 : 容忍 3 个节点故障仍可写、3 个仍可读

code:
from itertools import combinations

def dwidth(s):
    return sum(2 if ord(ch) > 0x2E7F else 1 for ch in s)


def pad(s, n):
    return s + " " * max(1, n - dwidth(s))

def quorum_ok(n, w, r):
    return (w + r) > n


def brute(n, w, r):
    nodes = list(range(n))
    ws = [frozenset(c) for c in combinations(nodes, w)]
    rs = [frozenset(c) for c in combinations(nodes, r)]
    for a in ws:
        for b in rs:
            if not (a & b):
                return False
    return True


CASES = [(3, 2, 2), (3, 1, 1), (3, 2, 1), (5, 3, 3), (5, 2, 3), (5, 1, 4), (4, 2, 2), (4, 2, 3)]

print("=== Quorum 读写集合：W + R > N 的强一致判据 ===")
print(pad("N", 6) + pad("W", 6) + pad("R", 6) + pad("W+R>N", 12)
      + pad("判据强一致", 16) + pad("枚举互证", 16) + "一致")
same_all = True
for n, w, r in CASES:
    a = quorum_ok(n, w, r)
    b = brute(n, w, r)
    same_all = same_all and (a == b)
    print(pad(str(n), 6) + pad(str(w), 6) + pad(str(r), 6)
          + pad("%d>%d" % (w + r, n), 12) + pad(str(a), 16) + pad(str(b), 16) + str(a == b))
print()
print("判据与暴力枚举完全一致 : %s" % same_all)
print()
print("容错能力（允许同时故障的节点数）：")
for n, w, r in [(5, 3, 3), (5, 2, 2), (3, 2, 2)]:
    print("  N=%d W=%d R=%d : 容忍 %d 个节点故障仍可写、%d 个仍可读" % (n, w, r, n - w, n - r))
print()
print("边界易错点：N=3,W=2,R=1 时 2+1=3 并不 > 3，读写集合可以完全不相交")
print("           （写 {n1,n2}、读 {n3}），因此不保证读到最新值。")
print("           W+R>N 是「交集恒非空」的充要条件（上面已用组合枚举逐例互证）。")
